title: iOS 27.3 Adds 'Ask About Page' Siri AI Feature to Safari
excerpt: The second beta of iOS 27.3 includes a new "Ask About Page" feature for Siri AI. Siri can see the entire content of a webpage, including...
content_html:
Monday November 16, 2026 10:24 am PST by Juli Clover

The second beta of iOS 27.3 includes a new "Ask About Page" feature for Siri AI.


‌Siri‌ can see the entire content of a webpage, including content that isn't currently in view on the screen. If you're looking at a website with a long menu, for example, you can ask ‌Siri‌ to surface all of the options that are gluten-free. Or if you're getting ready for a trip, you can ask ‌Siri‌ to read through a long guide and put together a packing list based on what's on the page.

Right now, ‌Siri‌ has on-screen intelligence, but it relies on what's in view. Access to a full webpage will make ‌Siri‌ more useful for summarizing content.

In the first beta of iOS 27.3, Apple expanded what ‌Siri‌ can do in and across apps like Calendar, Files, Finder, Journal, Mail, Maps, Messages, Music, Notes, Photos, Preview, Reminders, Safari, Shortcuts, and Weather.

In Mail, for example, ‌Siri‌ can unsubscribe you from mailing lists and undo recently sent messages. In Weather, ‌Siri‌ can add locations to your weather list, or control weather notifications. In Safari, ‌Siri‌ can clear browsing history, manage tabs and windows, save articles to a Reading List, and close duplicate tabs. In Files, ‌Siri‌ can organize content, delete files you haven't accessed for a set period of time, and more.

Apple is also allowing third-party integration for ‌Siri‌ AI, so any app will be able to bring its contents and actions directly into ‌Siri‌ AI.
